items.title: Registered Autistic OKUs Rise 24% To Over 93,000 In Malaysia
items.summary: The number of OKUs with autism registered with JKM rose 23.5% to 93,199 people in June 2026 from 75,457 registered in June 2025. Senator Lingeshwaran wants fast-track warrants for speech therapy officers, occupational therapists, and audiology officers. The post Registered Autistic OKUs Rise 24% To Over 93,000 In Malaysia appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: JPA Approves Over 13,000 New Positions For Health Workers
items.summary: JPA approved 13,343 new positions without trade-offs for MOH, including 1,197 for medical officers and 3,471 for nurses. Amid 15,587 existing nursing vacancies, MOH must hire over 19,000 nurses, likely to take eight years by 2034, assuming no one quits. The post JPA Approves Over 13,000 New Positions For Health Workers appeared first on CodeBlue .
